clips.title: The story
paras: Merrin Rockweaver sends word from the Whelgar's Excavation site after mottled raptors overrun the dig. Her letter tells Tarrel Rockweaver that she survived, while most of the expedition did not.

Merrin Rockweaver has a report for you from the ridge above Whelgar's Excavation site. The team was uncovering rare artifacts and massive prehistoric fossils when packs of mottled raptors swept through the dig. Most of the crew died in the attack. Merrin and the other survivors remain cut off from Menethil Harbor.

At Menethil Harbor, Tarrel Rockweaver learns that his wife survived with at least two companions. Ormer's courage helped them escape, easing Tarrel's fear. The deaths of so many colleagues still weigh on the town and its frontier spirit.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It was horrible! We were uncovering some rare artifacts and we began to discover these large bones.
Before we knew what was happening, these Mottled Raptors overwhelmed the dig site. Many lives were lost.
Ormer here -- so brave -- saved the Prospector and me. He defended us as we ran for shelter. Now we are trapped. And our hard work lies in ruin.
Here, take this note back to my sweet Tarrel. It will explain the situation to him.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to find Merrin? Did she send word?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Such horrible news! At least 3 of them survived. But when will the killing end? I long for the day when King Magni's subjects can live without fear.
